info.name: Get span annotations filtered by span_ids and/or identifier.

params.name: project_identifier
params.description: The project identifier: either project ID or project name. If using a project name as the identifier, it cannot contain slash (/), question mark (?), or pound sign (#) characters.

params.name: span_ids
params.description: Optional list of span ids to fetch annotations for. If omitted, `identifier` must be supplied.

params.name: identifier
params.description: Optional list of annotation identifiers to filter by. Each value must be non-empty. If omitted, `span_ids` must be supplied. When combined with `span_ids`, results are the AND-intersection of both filters.

params.name: include_annotation_names
params.description: Optional list of annotation names to include. If provided, only annotations with these names will be returned (allowlist). When omitted, the response includes every matching row regardless of name (no annotation names are excluded by default).

params.name: exclude_annotation_names
params.description: Optional list of annotation names to exclude from results.

params.name: cursor
params.description: A cursor for pagination

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of annotations to return in a single request

items.docs: Return span annotations for a project, filtered by `span_ids`, `identifier`, or both. At least one of `span_ids` or `identifier` must be supplied. When both are supplied, results are the AND-intersection of the two filters.

info.name: Delete span annotations in a project that match the supplied filter.

params.name: project_identifier
params.description: The project identifier: either project ID or project name. If using a project name as the identifier, it cannot contain slash (/), question mark (?), or pound sign (#) characters.

params.name: name
params.description: Optional annotation name. When provided, must be non-empty and narrows the delete to annotations of that name.

params.name: identifier
params.description: Optional annotation identifier. When provided, must be non-empty and narrows the delete to annotations with that identifier.

params.name: annotator_kind
params.description: Optional annotator kind. When provided, narrows the delete to annotations produced by this annotator kind.

params.name: start_time
params.description: Optional inclusive lower bound on `created_at` (>=). Naive datetimes are interpreted as UTC.

params.name: end_time
params.description: Optional exclusive upper bound on `created_at` (<). Naive datetimes are interpreted as UTC.

params.name: delete_all
params.description: Opt-in flag that authorizes the request without a bounded `[start_time, end_time)` time window. When `false` (default) or absent, the request must supply both `start_time` AND `end_time` to bound the delete. When `true`, the time-range bound is waived and any other filters (`name`, `identifier`, `annotator_kind`) still narrow the delete within the project — e.g. `delete_all=true&name=X` deletes all annotations named X regardless of time.

items.docs:
Hard-delete span annotations within the named project that match the
supplied filter.

- The request must either supply both `start_time` AND `end_time`
  to bound the delete to a `[start_time, end_time)` time window,
  OR set `delete_all=true` to acknowledge an unbounded sweep. A request
  that satisfies neither is rejected with 422.
- `name`, `identifier`, and `annotator_kind` are optional narrowing
  filters; on their own they do NOT authorize the request — they only
  narrow within an alread
